While memory costs are expected to easily dominate the bill of materials of the iPhone 18 Pro, the same may not be true of the iPhone Duo. Here's what we know.

Apple signs three-year exclusive supply deal with Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital claimed on Weibo today that Apple has signed a three-year exclusive folding panel supply deal with Samsung Display.

According to the leaker, Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of folding panels for the iPhone Duo "and its successors," with each panel costing approximately $250.

The leaker also noted that, unsurprising, the display is "one of the most expensive core components" of the device.

While there isn't yet a credible iPhone Duo bill of materials estimate, Apple has shared interesting information about the materials used in the device through teardowns of the display, camera, processor, memory, and other components, including how much recycled material is included.
